title: Degeneration Theorems of Connes and Feigin--Tsygan Type in Mixed Characteristic, with q-Analogues
summary: We prove mixed-characteristic analogues of the Connes and Feigin--Tsygan degeneration theorem. Let $W=W(k)$ be the Witt vectors of a perfect field of characteristic $p>0$. For a smooth proper variety $X$ over $W$, the de Rham-to-$\HP$ spectral sequence is split degenerate under the small-dimension hypothesis $dim(X/W)<p-1$. More generally, if $X$ is smooth and proper over the ring of integers $O_K$ of a finite extension of $\mathrm{Frac}(W)$ with ramification index $e$, we prove the corresponding split degeneration under $2e dim(X/O_K)<p-1$.
